normal.name: Trevor Gunter
normal.text: What are you talking about? Doom, like nearly all DOS games, ran in 320x200 resolution at 70 Hz, scan doubled to 400 lines because the VGA monitor standard didn't support frequencies less than 31.5 kHz. Doom only ran at 35 fps because even the fastest computers at the time couldn't manage 70.

normal.text: Ok fair enough. Not a purist with retro stuff by any means but I do think the experience of playing the carts specifically (not NGCD) on OG hardware/sticks etc is the best NG experience.
